How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders placed by 12:00 PM EST ship out the same business day, while orders placed after that time, or on weekends/holidays, ship on the following business day.
Once your order ships, you will receive an email with your tracking number. In rare cases where an item is out of stock, it can take up to 7 business days to process before shipping.

Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Once shipped, domestic delivery times generally depend on the shipping method selected at checkout. Packages are shipped via standard services like UPS or USPS.
If you placed your order within the continental U.S., standard flat-rate and free shipping typically take a few business days once in transit, while upgraded options like Second Day or Next Day Air offer faster delivery.
